STAR-K names a certifier on many beers via a "Certified By X" note. That places the record in List 1, but symbol_required_on_bottle is null - STAR-K does not say the symbol must be on the package, so it is never inferred.
Hard Cider, Hard Seltzer, Mead and Sake are separate published cRc categories and are NOT included.
No kosher status, note, symbol or brand/product wording was altered.
